dedupe_keys.name: smoderp2d distributed runoff and erosion model

description: SMODERP2D is a distributed event-based model of surface and subsurface runoff and soil erosion maintained by the STORM research group. Its public repository includes a command-line runner, GRASS GIS and QGIS integration, test configurations and a user manual. Users provide a terrain grid, soils, land cover, rainfall event and model parameters. Outputs represent runoff, rill flow and erosion across the selected catchment and event period. Geographic coverage and grid resolution depend on the prepared site inputs. GPL-3.0 source is available without a fee. A limitation is that predictions for infrastructure sites depend on terrain quality and event calibration; the program is not itself a validated flood-defence design standard. It can model hillside runoff reaching roads, buildings and drainage networks. The catalogue's model-lisflood-fp is a separate flood-inundation model, not the same erosion solver. No terrain data, executable or Docker image was downloaded.
